The tweet is titled "The Oldest Lighthouse in Asia!" and discusses an intriguing structure atop a large grey-white granite rock known as Mahishasuramardini Mandapa, which is also referred to as the Olakkannesvara Mandir. The tweet includes a photograph that shows a panoramic view of the area surrounding the mandapa. The mandapa itself is a small, square-shaped stone structure with intricate carvings on its walls.
